title: Score is shown as 'X/366' from turn 1, and I reached the literal cap of 366/366 while three of the eight holds (Wardmoor, the Saltkerns, Emberfall) were never visited and several open quests (Perrin's Mother, The Slag-Hound, Berin's Coin Road, The Oath That Never Ended, The Surveyor's Stakes, The Muster in the Barn) were left undone — unclear whether 366 is a true full-completion denominator or a per-route ceiling.
